summary: 1933 14x14 L-4 cab on Round Mountain, Deschutes National Forest; staffed in summer, standing at a 2023 visit, NHLR-registered 2003.

facts.design: 14 by 14 foot L-4 hip-roof ground cabin

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Emergency lookouts used the summit from 1928 and 1930. The permanent cab was completed in 1933. Forest Lookouts' note gives 1932 for construction and 1933 for observation; the register and Cheryl Hill use 1933.

notes_for_editor: History rests on the NHLR detail page, firelookout.com, Cheryl Hill's November 2023 visit, and Forest Lookouts' extracts of Bend Bulletin items (quoted from newspapers, not checked against the scans). Build year: NHLR, Cheryl Hill and the Forest Lookouts summary give 1933; Forest Lookouts' note says construction in 1932. Elevation disagrees: NHLR 5,835 ft (1,779 m) against 5,900 ft on Cheryl Hill and firelookout.com. The record's 1778.5 m is left unchanged. Current staffing and access come from a 2023 visit and undated pages; no 2025 or 2026 source found, so recheck with the Bend-Fort Rock Ranger District before a visit. No rental listing found and none is claimed. No new photos added.
